points.description: Correctly computes the daily requirement as 2000 calories (e.g. 40 ÷ 0.02 = 2000, or 40 × 50 = 2000), with every step mathematically valid; equivalent correct methods earn the mark.

rubric.notes: Full marks require a correct final answer of 2000 calories reached by valid reasoning. A single invalid step or an incorrect final answer earns no marks, since the scheme is all-or-nothing. No partial credit is available.
